role: Veterinary practice controlled-drug accountable clinician, reviewing one drug's register line per audit period
setting: A multi-branch small-animal and equine practice group runs a monthly controlled-drug audit. For each drug, strength and branch, the reviewer opens one record bundling the register page, the patient records that cite that drug, the physical stock count, disposal records and any approved variance exceptions. The reviewer decides whether the line can be closed, how large and of what kind any discrepancy is, and how complete the authentication is. The figures in the record are the only evidence.

unexplained_shortfall.instructions: Evidence shows an unexplained stock shortfall on this register line.

line_disposition.instructions: What should the reviewer do with this register line now?

criteria.sign_off: Line fully reconciles and every entry is properly authenticated.
criteria.correct_and_sign: Only clerical slips, fixable by dated annotation without further evidence.
criteria.hold_pending: One missing confirmation must arrive before the line can close.
criteria.escalate: Unexplained loss or unlogged removal needs a director or regulator report.

variance_cause.instructions: Which cause accounts for the largest share of the variance?

criteria.no_discrepancy: Closing count matches the register once documented adjustments are applied.
criteria.arithmetic_slip: Largest variance comes from a running balance miscalculated between entries.
criteria.unrecorded_administration: Largest variance matches clinical-record doses missing from the register.
criteria.undocumented_disposal: Largest variance matches stock removed without any register disposal entry.
criteria.unexplained_loss: Largest variance has no matching counterpart anywhere in the record.

variance_size.instructions: How large is the unreconciled variance relative to volume handled?
criteria: Nil: no variance remains after documented adjustments
Trace: remaining variance below 2% of volume handled
Material: remaining variance from 2% up to 10%
Major: remaining variance above 10% of volume handled

auth_gaps.instructions: How many register entries lack a required signature or witness?
criteria: Every entry carries all required signatures and witnesses
Exactly one entry lacks a signature or witness
Two or three entries lack a signature or witness
Four or more entries lack a signature or witness

factors.name: drug_profile
factors.description: Drug, strength and schedule of the line; sets whether administrations need a witness and the typical volumes handled.

factors.name: arithmetic_slip_count
factors.description: Number of entries whose running balance does not equal the prior balance minus or plus that entry's quantity.

factors.name: unrecorded_admin
factors.description: Volume of doses present in clinical records for this drug and period with no matching register entry.

factors.name: clinical_records_missing
factors.description: Clinical records section arrives null because the practice-management export failed, so administrations cannot be cross-checked.

factors.name: disposal_state
factors.description: Status of expired or broken stock leaving the line: none needed, witnessed and entered, entered without witness, or removed with no register entry.

factors.name: unexplained_shortfall_pct
factors.description: Shortfall of physical count against the corrected register balance that matches no clinical record, disposal or exception, as a percentage of volume handled.

factors.name: variance_exception
factors.description: Approved variance exception (breakage report or spillage sign-off) and whether it is in date and covers the full or partial shortfall.

factors.name: manufacturer_overfill
factors.description: Batch carries a documented manufacturer overfill allowance, producing a small surplus that offsets apparent shortfall or creates a benign overage.

factors.name: auth_gap_count
factors.description: Number of register entries missing the administering signature or, for drugs requiring it, the witness id.

factors.name: count_out_of_order
factors.description: Physical stock count dated before the final register entry of the period, so the count does not reflect the closing balance.

factors.name: unit_mismatch
factors.description: Clinical records state doses in mg or mcg while the register uses ml, requiring conversion via the header concentration.

factors.name: locum_signatory
factors.description: Some entries signed by a locum staff id that looks unfamiliar but appears in the branch roster for those dates.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Remaining variance placed within 0.3 percentage points of 2% or 10%, or two causes of nearly equal volume.

sections.name: register_header
sections.description: Drug, strength, concentration_mg_ml, schedule, witness_required, branch_id, page_id, period_start, period_end, opening_balance_ml.

sections.name: entries
sections.description: List of register lines: entry_id, date, type, qty_ml, patient_id, running_balance_ml, signed_by, witness_id, batch_no.

sections.name: clinical_records
sections.description: List of patient dose records: patient_id, date, dose, dose_unit, route, clinician_id; or null when export failed.

sections.name: stock_check
sections.description: Physical count: count_date, counted_ml, counted_by, checked_by, batch_no, overfill_allowance_ml.

sections.name: disposals
sections.description: List of disposal events: batch_no, qty_ml, reason_code, removed_date, register_entry_id, witness_id, denatured_date.

sections.name: exceptions
sections.description: List of approved variance exceptions: exception_id, batch_no, qty_ml, reason_code, approved_by, valid_from, valid_to.

rendering_notes: drug_profile sets register_header fields including witness_required (true for schedule 2 drugs) and plausible entry volumes. arithmetic_slip_count appears only as running_balance_ml values inconsistent with the previous balance and qty_ml; the reviewer must recompute. unrecorded_admin appears as clinical_records items whose patient_id and date have no entries line; when unit_mismatch is true the dose is in mg or mcg and must be divided by concentration_mg_ml to compare, and some correctly recorded doses are also shown in mg as decoys. clinical_records_missing renders clinical_records as null; this is a single missing confirmation (hold) unless other signals escalate. disposal_state: witnessed_complete has a disposals item with register_entry_id, witness_id and denatured_date; entered_unwitnessed has register_entry_id but witness_id null (counts as a missing confirmation, not variance); removed_unlogged has a disposals item with register_entry_id null and no matching entries line, so its qty_ml sits inside the count shortfall. unexplained_shortfall_pct is realised only as stock_check.counted_ml being lower than the recomputed balance by an amount not matched by any clinical record, disposal or exception. variance_exception renders exceptions items; expired_or_other_batch has valid_to before the event or a different batch_no, so it is a decoy that must not be applied; valid_partial_cover covers only part of the shortfall. manufacturer_overfill sets stock_check.overfill_allowance_ml above zero and may produce a small count surplus that is benign. auth_gap_count renders signed_by null or, where witness_required is true, witness_id null; witness_id null is not a gap when witness_required is false (decoy). count_out_of_order sets stock_check.count_date earlier than the last entries date, making the comparison unreliable and favouring hold. locum_signatory uses a staff id format unlike the others yet valid, a decoy against escalation. Remaining variance for variance_size is the recomputed closing balance minus counted_ml, after applying valid exceptions and overfill allowance, divided by opening_balance_ml plus receipts. No field states a reconciled status, variance percentage, cause, risk level or disposition; there are no free-text fields; unknown values are null.
